nodes.name: NF pretreatment
nodes.procedure: The NF was cut into a rectangular shape with an area of 1.0 cm × 2.0 cm. The pieces of NF were washed with 3M HCl, ethanol and deionized water, respectively.
nodes.source_text: First, the NF was cut into a rectangular shape with an area of 1.0 cm × 2.0 cm. Second, the pieces of NF were washed with 3M HCl, ethanol and deionized water, respectively.

nodes.name: NiMoO4 hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: 4 mmol of Ni(NO3)2·6H2O, 0.14 mmol of (NH4)6Mo7O24·4H2O (Ni:Mo = 4:1), and 15 mL of deionized water were combined in a 25 mL Teflon autoclave and thoroughly dissolved. The autoclave was sealed and subjected to 150°C for 6 h. Upon natural cooling, the NF bearing the products was retrieved, rinsed with deionized water, and air-dried.

nodes.name: B-doped Ni4Mo synthesis
nodes.procedure: 100 mg H3BO3 was dissolved in 1 mL of deionized water and completely dissolved by ultrasound. Subsequently, the prepared dispersion (100 μL) was slowly dropped onto NiMoO4/NF covering an area of 1.0 cm×2.0 cm and dried in air. Then, it was heated at 500°C for 3 h in a H2/Ar (20:80) atmosphere in a tubular furnace.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM images show B_{4.7}-Ni_4Mo/NF maintains nanorod array structure as NiMoO_4/NF with cuboid nanorods, rough surface, and minute pores (Fig. 1a-c).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The morphology of the NiMoO_4 / NF was observed by SEM, which revealed dense and smooth arrays of NiMoO_4·xH_2O nanorods arranged vertically on nickel foam (Figs. S2a and 2b). The morphology of B_{4,7}-Ni_4Mo / NF was examined through scanning electron microscopy (SEM) ... The nanorod array grows neatly on the NF (Fig. 1a), providing a rich channel for gas release. The nanorods exhibit a cuboid shape and possess a rough surface (Fig. 1b-c).

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM shows B_{4.7}-Ni_4Mo/NF nanorod array structure with rough and porous configuration.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The morphology of B_{4,7}-Ni_4Mo / NF was examined through ... transmission electron microscopy (TEM) for further characterization.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM exhibits lattice fringes with spacing of 0.211 nm corresponding to (121) plane of Ni_4Mo; lattice spacing expanded by ~0.04 nm compared to Ni_4Mo (0.207 nm).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) and fast Fourier transform (FFT) of the HRTEM pattern (Fig. 1e) exhibit apparent lattice fringes with a spacing of 0.211 nm, corresponding to the (121) plane of Ni_4Mo.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD peaks at 43.5°, 50.4°, 74.7° correspond to (121), (310), (312) planes of Ni_4Mo (PDF #65-5480); B_{4.7}-Ni_4Mo shows reduced peak intensity and minor shift indicating lattice enlargement.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As illustrated in Fig. 1 f, the peaks observed at 43.5°, 50.4°, and 74.7° correspond to the (121), (310), and (312) crystal planes of Ni_4Mo (PDF #65-5480).

nodes.characterization_summary: STEM-EDS mapping and line scans show uniform distribution of Ni, Mo, and B throughout B_{4.7}-Ni_4Mo/NF nanorods with B primarily associated with Ni and Mo.
nodes.evidence_snippet: To confirm the successful integration of interstitial boron atoms into Ni_4Mo, STEM and EDS elemental analyses were conducted ... The distribution of Ni, Mo, and B was found to be uniform throughout the nanorod.

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-AES quantifies B_x-Ni_4Mo powder composition (results in Table S1).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The B_x - N_i_4Mo powder sonicated off of nickel foam was quantified by using inductively coupled plasma-atomic emission spectrometry (ICP-AES) and the results are presented in Table S1.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS shows Mo 3d in Ni_4Mo/NF: Mo^0 (227.6 eV 3d_{5/2}, 231.0 eV 3d_{3/2}), Mo^{4+} (228.5 eV 3d_{5/2}, 232.0 eV 3d_{3/2}), Mo^{6+} (232.2 eV 3d_{5/2}, 235.4 eV 3d_{3/2}); B_{4.7}-Ni_4Mo/NF: reduced Mo^{4+}, absent Mo^{6+}, Mo^0 peaks shift +0.4 eV; Ni 2p shifts +0.3 eV; B 1s: 188.4 eV (B-metal bond), 192.5 eV (B-O).
nodes.evidence_snippet: In Ni_4Mo/NF, we observed three sets of peaks. Specifically, the peaks at 227.6 eV and 231.0 eV are attributed to Mo^0 3d_{5/2} and 3d_{3/2} ... In the case of interstitial B-doped Ni_4Mo/NF, the Mo^{4+} peak reduces significantly, and Mo^{6+} peak is absent ... The B 1 s XPS spectrum of B_{4.7} - Ni_4Mo / NF (Fig. 2c) shows a peak at 188.4 eV belonging to the boron and metal bonding.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiMoO_4/NF shows peaks at 828, 871, 948 cm^{-1} (Ni-O-Mo), 353 cm^{-1} (Mo-O); Ni_4Mo shows small peak at 948 cm^{-1}; B_{4.7}-Ni_4Mo/NF shows no Raman peaks.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The three peaks at 828, 871, and 948 cm^{-1} in NiMoO_4 / NF can be attributed to the Ni-O-Mo stretching vibrations, while the peak at 353 cm^{-1} is assignable to Mo-O vibrations.
